name: Haus Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Alpenrose is located in Sölden, Tirol. It offers accommodation in several rooms. The restaurant serves Austrian and Tirol specialties. The interior is in traditional style. The Gasthof is a starting point for hikes in summer. In winter, guests can use ski areas in the surrounding area. Parking is available at the house. The reception is staffed at fixed times.
